input.query: fetch logs | filter isNotNull(mule.environment) | fieldsAdd mule.environment | dedup mule.environment | fields value = mule.environment | sort value asc
fetch logs | filter isNotNull(mule.app) | fieldsAdd mule.app | dedup mule.app | fields value = mule.app | sort value asc
fetch logs | filter isNotNull(mule.api.name) | dedup mule.api.name | fields value = mule.api.name | sort value asc

0.content:
## MuleSoft Anypoint Observability
Logs from CloudHub app workers · Flex/Omni Gateway · Anypoint Audit  
> Filter by **Environment**, **Application**, and **API** above

4.title: App Log Volume by Level
4.query:
fetch logs, from:now()-2h
| filter event.type == "mule.app.log"
| filter in(mule.environment, $environment) OR arraySize(toArray($environment)) == 0
| filter in(mule.app, $app) OR arraySize(toArray($app)) == 0
| makeTimeseries count(), by: {mule.level}, time: {default}, interval: auto

5.title: App Error Rate (% ERROR logs)
5.query:
fetch logs, from:now()-2h
| filter event.type == "mule.app.log"
| filter in(mule.environment, $environment) OR arraySize(toArray($environment)) == 0
| filter in(mule.app, $app) OR arraySize(toArray($app)) == 0
| makeTimeseries
    total = count(),
    errors = countIf(mule.is_error == true),
    interval: auto
| fieldsAdd error_rate = errors / total * 100

6.title: Top Flows by Error Count
6.query:
fetch logs, from:now()-2h
| filter event.type == "mule.app.log" AND mule.is_error == true
| filter in(mule.environment, $environment) OR arraySize(toArray($environment)) == 0
| filter in(mule.app, $app) OR arraySize(toArray($app)) == 0
| summarize errors = count(), by: {mule.app, mule.flow}
| sort errors desc
| limit 20

7.title: Recent Error Logs
7.query:
fetch logs, from:now()-1h
| filter event.type == "mule.app.log" AND mule.is_error == true
| filter in(mule.environment, $environment) OR arraySize(toArray($environment)) == 0
| filter in(mule.app, $app) OR arraySize(toArray($app)) == 0
| fields timestamp, mule.app, mule.flow, mule.correlationId, mule.message
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 50

8.title: API Request Volume by Status Class
8.query:
fetch logs, from:now()-2h
| filter event.type == "mule.gateway.access"
| filter in(mule.environment, $environment) OR arraySize(toArray($environment)) == 0
| filter in(mule.api.name, $api) OR arraySize(toArray($api)) == 0
| fieldsAdd status_class = concat(toString(toLong(mule.api.statusCode / 100)), "xx")
| makeTimeseries count(), by: {status_class}, interval: auto

9.title: API p50 / p95 / p99 Latency (ms)
9.query:
fetch logs, from:now()-2h
| filter event.type == "mule.gateway.access"
| filter in(mule.environment, $environment) OR arraySize(toArray($environment)) == 0
| filter in(mule.api.name, $api) OR arraySize(toArray($api)) == 0
| makeTimeseries
    p50 = percentile(mule.api.duration_ms, 50),
    p95 = percentile(mule.api.duration_ms, 95),
    p99 = percentile(mule.api.duration_ms, 99),
    interval: auto

10.title: API Error Rate by API Name
10.query:
fetch logs, from:now()-2h
| filter event.type == "mule.gateway.access"
| filter in(mule.environment, $environment) OR arraySize(toArray($environment)) == 0
| filter in(mule.api.name, $api) OR arraySize(toArray($api)) == 0
| summarize
    total = count(),
    errors_5xx = countIf(mule.is_error == true),
    errors_4xx = countIf(mule.is_4xx == true),
    by: {mule.api.name}
| fieldsAdd
    rate_5xx = round(errors_5xx / total * 100, decimals: 2),
    rate_4xx = round(errors_4xx / total * 100, decimals: 2)
| sort errors_5xx desc

11.title: Top Paths by Request Count
11.query:
fetch logs, from:now()-2h
| filter event.type == "mule.gateway.access"
| filter in(mule.environment, $environment) OR arraySize(toArray($environment)) == 0
| filter in(mule.api.name, $api) OR arraySize(toArray($api)) == 0
| summarize
    requests = count(),
    avg_ms = avg(mule.api.duration_ms),
    errors = countIf(mule.is_error == true),
    by: {mule.api.name, mule.api.method, mule.api.path}
| sort requests desc
| limit 20

12.title: Policy Violations Over Time
12.query:
fetch logs, from:now()-2h
| filter event.type == "mule.gateway.access" AND mule.api.policyViolations > 0
| filter in(mule.environment, $environment) OR arraySize(toArray($environment)) == 0
| makeTimeseries sum(mule.api.policyViolations), by: {mule.api.name}, interval: auto

13.title: Gateway Upstream vs End-to-End Latency
13.query:
fetch logs, from:now()-2h
| filter event.type == "mule.gateway.access"
| filter in(mule.api.name, $api) OR arraySize(toArray($api)) == 0
| makeTimeseries
    e2e_p95 = percentile(mule.api.duration_ms, 95),
    upstream_p95 = percentile(mule.api.upstream.ms, 95),
    interval: auto

14.title: Audit Events by Action Type
14.query:
fetch logs, from:now()-24h
| filter event.type == "mule.audit"
| summarize count(), by: {mule.audit.action, mule.audit.objectType, mule.audit.success}
| sort count() desc

15.title: Failed Audit Events
15.query:
fetch logs, from:now()-24h
| filter event.type == "mule.audit" AND mule.audit.success == false
| fields timestamp, mule.audit.userName, mule.audit.action, mule.audit.objectType, mule.audit.objectName, mule.org
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 50

16.title: Audit Activity by User (top 10)
16.query:
fetch logs, from:now()-24h
| filter event.type == "mule.audit"
| summarize
    total = count(),
    failures = countIf(mule.audit.success == false),
    by: {mule.audit.userName}
| sort total desc
| limit 10

17.title: Deploy Events Timeline
17.query:
fetch logs, from:now()-24h
| filter event.type == "mule.audit" AND mule.audit.action =~ "Deploy|Undeploy|Restart"
| fields timestamp, mule.audit.userName, mule.audit.action, mule.audit.objectName, mule.audit.success, mule.environment
| sort timestamp desc

18.title: Overall Log Health — KPI
18.query:
fetch logs, from:now()-1h
| filter event.type =~ "mule.*"
| summarize
    total = count(),
    app_errors = countIf(event.type == "mule.app.log" AND mule.is_error == true),
    api_5xx = countIf(event.type == "mule.gateway.access" AND mule.is_error == true),
    api_4xx = countIf(event.type == "mule.gateway.access" AND mule.is_4xx == true),
    audit_failures = countIf(event.type == "mule.audit" AND mule.audit.success == false)
| fieldsAdd
    app_error_rate = round(app_errors / total * 100, decimals: 2),
    api_5xx_rate   = round(api_5xx / total * 100, decimals: 2)
